title: A bacterial (prokaryotic) cell
caption: A bacterial cell has a cell wall, a cell membrane and cytoplasm, like many other cells, but there is no nucleus: its DNA is a single loop lying in the cytoplasm. Many bacteria also have small rings of DNA called plasmids.
alt: A rod-shaped bacterial cell with labels: cell wall, cell membrane, cytoplasm, single loop of DNA, and plasmid (small ring of DNA). There is no nucleus.
description: The outer layer is the cell wall.
Inside it is the cell membrane, which surrounds the cytoplasm.
The DNA is a single loop in the cytoplasm, not inside a nucleus.
A plasmid is a small separate ring of DNA.
